calibration: Retain each menu's own original frozen intercept, slope and clipping. Replace only selected_threshold and selected_fixed_policy for each analysis cell. No fitting or selection from these results.

policies.fixed_forced: Answer at the specified fixed round regardless of confidence.
policies.fixed_selective: Answer only at the specified fixed round iff calibrated confidence >= specified threshold, otherwise no later answer and terminal PASS at round 5.
policies.adaptive_forced: Answer at first crossing of specified threshold, otherwise force an answer at round 5.
policies.adaptive_selective: Answer at first crossing of specified threshold, otherwise terminal PASS at round 5.

inference.unit: question; average four rotations within question and use shared bootstrap indices across all settings, menus and policies
inference.focal_reward_contrasts: Adaptive selective minus fixed selective for each of the 2 menus times 4 settings
inference.focal_adjustment: Bonferroni family size 8 for this added analysis only; does not cover earlier adaptive analyses
inference.menu_difference_in_gains: For each setting, (AS-FS)_same_category minus (AS-FS)_independent, paired on question; descriptive 95% intervals
inference.menu_policy_differences: For each setting and policy, same_category minus independent; descriptive 95% intervals
inference.conditional_error: wrong answers / committed answers, ratio recomputed within each bootstrap resample

validation: Verify original input identity and saved-score validation through the existing fixed-abstention loader.
Exactly reproduce all 3200 earlier episode outcomes in the two original menu-specific settings.
Adaptive policy episodes must be identical across fixed rounds at the same threshold.
Fixed-forced episodes must be identical across thresholds at the same fixed round.
Do not treat repeated episodes across settings or rotations as independent samples.
limitations: Crossing numerical thresholds and rounds still retains different per-menu calibrators; it is not a shared end-to-end decision rule or pure causal menu intervention.
This is a sensitivity analysis of two thresholds and two fixed rounds, not optimization of the fixed-selective policy.
The 100 questions were previously inspected. No fresh-data, preregistration or confirmation claim.
Different menus can change answer correctness, confidence and acceptance sets; reward, coverage and error must be reported together.
Intervals condition on original fitted calibrators and omit calibration-fit uncertainty.
